messages.body: Canvas updated the exam page today. Take-home is 25 points, in-person is 30 — 55 total, not the 50/50 split the tracker had. messages.title: How are you getting home Tuesdays? The last bus is 8 minutes after lab
messages.body: Looked up the schedules while setting up the gym plan and found something that matters more than the gym. The last trip out of DCCC leaves around 9:53 PM (115 to 111, or 118 to 110 at 10:12), getting you home about 11:07. BIO lab ends at 9:45. That is an eight-minute margin, and there is nothing after it — the next bus is 5:24 AM. So: have you been catching it, riding with someone, or has Scholz been letting out early? If it's the bus, Tuesday nights need a fallback on file, because one long lab and you're stranded in Marple. Everything else is fine — the 110/111 corridor between home, work and the gym runs to about midnight.

messages.title: New pack: MAT 151 Test 1 review, built from Abebe's own review sheet
messages.body: Abebe posted his own 23-problem Test 1 review set (with answer key) on Canvas -- same kind of gift the CHE sample exam was for Exam 1. Built four files from it: mat151-test1-review-practice.md (all 23 problems worked and independently verified, not copied from the key -- I actually found two spots where the scanned PDF's own printed key was wrong, a lost square root and a lost digit, both explained in the file), mat151-test1-review-study-guide.md (test logistics -- bring a laptop -- plus a 3-session plan), mat151-test1-review-pack.md (NotebookLM source), and mat151-test1-review-cards.txt (27 cards). Test 1 is Thursday 9/24. Quiz 4 is Tuesday 9/22 and covers 2.1-2.3 -- separate material, don't mix the two up.
